# `assets/vehicle/ChassisDetector.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/vehicle/ChassisDetector.js`

engine/assets/vehicle/ChassisDetector.js — identify the chassis + body parts (spec §11). The chassis is the largest non-wheel mesh; remaining meshes are categorized by name (glass/lights/doors) so segmentation and material edits (tint glass, emissive headlights, detach doors) can target them.

## Functions

### `detectChassis(model, wheelNodeIds = [])`

Identify chassis + body part nodes, excluding the given wheel node ids.

**Returns:** }
